🛒 CALGARY GROCERY DEALS: Week Ending Oct 7, 2026 🦃
Thanksgiving turkeys are cheap everywhere, and bacon hit a record low. Here's your store-by-store plan.

📍 SOBEYS
Overall: 276 deals, strongest meat lineup this week

🥩 RAW PROTEINS:
• $2.19/lb RWA Frozen Grade A Turkey - 74% below avg, lowest price we've tracked
• $2.77/lb Fresh RWA Grade A Turkey - 46% below avg, lowest ever
• $2.99 Bacon - 65% below avg $8.43, lowest price on record
• $9.88/lb Top Sirloin Oven Roast - 36% below avg $15.38
• $3.89 Steelhead Trout Fillets - 27% below avg

🥬 PRODUCE:
• $1.99 McIntosh Apples - best price across stores
• $2.47 Clementines/Mandarins - best price across stores

• $1.99 Pot Pies - 74% below avg

💡 VERDICT: This is your Thanksgiving turkey and bacon stop.

🛒 Gobble Gobble, YYC! Thanksgiving Turkeys Hit Record Lows (Week Ending Oct 7)

Thanksgiving is Monday, Oct 12, and the flyers know it. Poultry is where the money is this week. Here's the best of 2,060 deals across Calgary stores.

🥩 RAW PROTEIN DEALS

🐷 PORK: A couple of real bargains, but most chops and shoulder cuts are priced above normal.
• $2.49 Pork Half Loin @ No Frills - lowest price we've tracked, 19% below avg $3.07. Slice your own chops and save.
• $6.99 Pork Back Ribs @ Co-op - 34% below avg $10.57 and $3 cheaper than Sobeys/Safeway
• $3.99 Bone-In Pork Shoulder Blade Steaks/Roast @ Co-op - 50 cents less than the $4.49 at Sobeys/Safeway, which is above their usual $3.82

🐔 CHICKEN: Strong week. Dark meat and wings are deeply discounted.
• $2.49 Chicken Drumsticks @ Superstore - 66% below avg $7.21, best price in the city
• $4.99 Western Family Chicken Breast @ Save-On - 54% below avg $10.74
• $4.99 Chicken Wings @ Superstore - half off the usual $9.96, best across stores
• $6.79 Maple Leaf Prime RWA Boneless Skinless @ Walmart - 37% below avg $10.73

🦃 TURKEY: The main event. Multiple stores are at their lowest prices on record.
• $1.74 Canada Grade A Turkey @ Walmart - cheapest bird in Calgary this week
• $2.19 RWA Frozen Grade A Turkey @ Safeway & Sobeys - lowest price on record, 74% below avg $8.53
• $2.77 Fresh RWA Grade A Turkey @ Sobeys - lowest on record, 45% below avg $5.08. No thawing needed.
• $18 Utility Frozen Turkey 3-5 kg @ Superstore & No Frills - lowest on record, 32% below avg $26.64. Perfect for small gatherings.

🐄 BEEF: The quietest category. One standout deal.
• $9.88 Boneless Top Sirloin Oven Roast @ Sobeys & Safeway - 36% below avg $15.38. A great alternative Thanksgiving roast.
• $4.98 Our Promise Medium Ground Beef @ Walmart - $2 less than regular ground at Sobeys/Safeway ($6.99)
• $7.49 Lean Ground Beef @ No Frills - 11% below avg $8.44, best lean price across stores

🐟 SEAFOOD: Salmon and tuna are the steals.
• $3.29 Atlantic Salmon Fillet @ Save-On - 65% below avg $9.42, best across stores
• $2.79 Yellowfin Tuna Steaks @ Co-op - lowest price on record, 47% below avg $5.27
• $3.89 Fresh Steelhead Trout Fillets @ Sobeys & Safeway - 27% below avg $5.31

🐑 LAMB:
• $5.99 NZ Short Cut Lamb Leg @ No Frills - 15% below avg $7.08

🛒 OTHER TOP DEALS

🥬 Produce:
• $0.78 Red Cabbage @ Walmart - lowest on record, 73% below avg $2.85
• $1.24 Bulk Sweet Potatoes @ Walmart - lowest on record, 36% off
• $1.49 Royal Gala Apples @ No Frills - 75% below avg $6.02

🧀 Dairy:
• $4.99 Butter @ Co-op - 28% below avg $6.98. Stock up for pie season.
• $4.98 Armstrong Cheese Blocks 400 g @ Walmart - lowest price tracked

🥖 Bakery:
• $2.99 Mini Croissants @ Sobeys & Safeway - lowest on record, 42% off
• $1.49 Biscuits @ Safeway - 64% below avg $4.11

🥫 Pantry:
• $1.27 Stuffing @ Co-op - 84% below avg $7.68. A Thanksgiving must.
• $3 No Name Honey 1 kg @ No Frills - lowest on record, 57% off
• $1.47 Campbell's Broth @ Walmart - 43% below avg, ideal for gravy

❄️ Frozen:
• $2.49 Compliments Lasagna @ Sobeys & Safeway - lowest on record, 75% below avg $10.10

☕ Coffee:
• $8.99 Nabob Ground Coffee @ Save-On - lowest on record, 45% off

📝 THIS WEEK'S WINNERS

🏆 Best protein to stock up on: TURKEY. Record lows at Safeway and Sobeys, and $1.74/lb at Walmart. Buy an extra bird for the freezer. Also grab Superstore drumsticks at $2.49.

💰 Best value category: POULTRY. It posted the highest average deal score of any protein this week.

⏸️ Skip or wait on: Regular ground beef, pork chops, and pork shoulder at Sobeys/Safeway, which are all priced above their usual levels. Also skip the $17.99 bacon packs and shrimp rings, which are well above normal.

Happy early Thanksgiving, Calgary! 🍂
